parts:
What would be the best way to create different layouts for the same app?  I wish to have a drop-down box to navigate to different 'pages' each with their own panels, headers, and procedures.  Is the best/only method conditional panels?

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Create Different Layouts
parts:
That's one way, another way would be to use tabsetPanel for a nice tabbed interface.

If you find pageWithSidebar too limiting you can start with bootstrapPage to give you a blank canvas to start from.
